hints.provider_aws: Thulu calls sts:GetCallerIdentity to confirm the key, then simulates the specific actions its tools need. If the key cannot call iam:SimulatePrincipalPolicy the credential still works — its capabilities are simply left undiscovered.
hints.provider_gcp: Paste the downloaded service-account key file. Thulu mints a short-lived access token from it to confirm the key works, then asks Google which of its tools' permissions the account actually holds.
hints.service_account_json_placeholder: Paste the whole .json file you downloaded from Google Cloud
hints.project_id: Only needed when the permissions should be checked against a different project than the key's own.
hints.provider_github: A personal access token. Classic tokens report their scopes, so Thulu can map them to tools; fine-grained tokens do not, and are accepted with their capabilities left undiscovered.
hints.token: Needs `repo` (pull requests and Actions); add `workflow` if agents edit .github/workflows.
hints.provider_http_header: A static secret that an MCP server reads from an HTTP header. The daemon's MCP proxy adds the header to each call, so the secret never reaches an agent container. Nothing generic can check such a token, so its state stays unknown until a call uses it.
hints.kind_header_basic: Sent as Authorization: Basic base64(user:token). Atlassian (Jira, Confluence) takes the account email and an API token this way.
hints.kind_header_custom: Sent as <name>: <value>, for servers that read their key from a header of their own.
hints.field_username: For Atlassian, the email of the account that created the API token.
hints.provider_oauth: Signs in to an MCP server that asks for OAuth (Slack, Atlassian, Linear) and keeps the tokens in the daemon. The daemon refreshes them and its MCP proxy sends them upstream; no agent container ever holds one. Connect from here or from MCPs.
hints.kind_oauth_mcp: Pick the registered MCP server; the daemon finds its authorization server and registers itself as a client when the server allows it.
hints.field_client_id: Only for servers without dynamic client registration (Slack): the client ID of the app you created there, with the redirect URL below.
hints.field_scope: Space-separated. Empty asks for what the server advertises.
hints.provider_figma: A Figma personal access token, read through the thulu-figma MCP. Thulu checks it with GET /v1/me; Figma reports neither the token's scopes nor its expiry, so capabilities stay undiscovered.
hints.figma_token: Mint it with current_user:read (Thulu checks the token with it), file_content:read, file_comments:read and projects:read. Read scopes only.
